headlines.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
headlines.summary: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

headlines.title: Israeli settlers damage Palestinian family’s homes in West Bank attack
headlines.summary: The Tubasi family was forced out months ago and has been denied a return by settlers despite an Israeli court order.

headlines.title: Trump downplays Russia, China support for Iran during talks with US troops
headlines.summary: Trump praises US troops for their role in the war on Iran and says he has spoken to Netanyahu in recent days.

headlines.flashpoint_name: Fed independence and US fiscal stress
headlines.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
headlines.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.

headlines.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals
headlines.summary: The U.S. planned a fresh tariff salvo on 14 trading partners, while offering some countries lower rates if they secure trade deals with Washington.

headlines.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
headlines.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.

geo.caveat: Each flashpoint is measured against its own trailing 30-day median, so a long-running conflict does not sit at maximum forever. This measures how loud a story is relative to its own normal - not what will happen.
